configurePresets.name: posix-x64
configurePresets.description: LP64 build, the target configuration. Object identities on the Wire Protocol are routed through a 64-bit-safe handle table (see EncodeDebuggerHandle/DecodeDebuggerHandle in Debugger.cpp), so this width carries the full debugger stack as well.

configurePresets.name: posix-x64-debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimised LP64 build. Use when stepping through GC or interpreter code, where RelWithDebInfo reports locals as <optimized out>.

configurePresets.name: posix-x64-soak
configurePresets.description: Long-running configuration: unoptimised, with heap validation at level 3, which checks the heap around compaction and reports corruption at the operation that causes it instead of days later somewhere unrelated. Far too slow to measure with.

configurePresets.name: posix-x64-memcheck
configurePresets.displayName: POSIX x86-64 -> build/posix64-memcheck (Debug + Wire Protocol, heap annotated for valgrind)
configurePresets.description: Describes the managed heap to valgrind memcheck, so a native access to a freed managed object or to uninitialised object memory is reported where it happens. Run under valgrind; NANOCLR_GC_STRESS=<n> adds a GC before every n-th allocation.

configurePresets.name: posix-x64-debugger
configurePresets.displayName: POSIX x86-64 -> build/posix64-wp (Debug + Wire Protocol debugger)
configurePresets.description: Builds the Wire Protocol debugger stack. Pair with the harness option --networkport to expose it over TCP.

configurePresets.name: posix-x86
configurePresets.description: ILP32 build via -m32. Gives the 12-byte CLR_RT_HeapBlock the embedded ARM targets use, so heap layout and GC behaviour match a device. Needs gcc/g++ multilib and linux-libc-dev:i386.

configurePresets.name: posix-x86-debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimised ILP32 build. Use when stepping through GC or interpreter code, where RelWithDebInfo reports locals as <optimized out>.

configurePresets.name: posix-x86-soak
configurePresets.description: Long-running configuration: unoptimised, with heap validation at level 3, which checks the heap around compaction and reports corruption at the operation that causes it instead of days later somewhere unrelated. Far too slow to measure with.

configurePresets.name: posix-x86-debugger
configurePresets.displayName: POSIX i386 -> build/posix32-wp (Debug + Wire Protocol debugger)
configurePresets.description: Builds the Wire Protocol debugger stack. Pair with the harness option --networkport to expose it over TCP.

configurePresets.name: posix-x86-memcheck
configurePresets.displayName: POSIX i386 -> build/posix32-memcheck (Debug + Wire Protocol, heap annotated for valgrind)
configurePresets.description: Same as posix-x64-memcheck with the 12-byte CLR_RT_HeapBlock of the embedded targets. Needs valgrind's x86 tools and libc6-dbg:i386.
